hypothesis.title: Keep the recurrence local to component execution
hypothesis.evidence: Current component solver reloads its owned vectors between stages; previous partial shared caches did not represent a fully local recurrence.
hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Use N10 pre-scaled operator interface to keep current FP32 physical residual/direction in one16KiB shared buffer for components<=512. Pack current per-row neighbor indices to local ranks, validate membership, and fuse shared writes into existing producers/barriers. Larger components retain global storage. Add512/516-node interleaved analytic boundary cases; measure resource cost and whole-step benefit.
hypothesis.estimated_application_ms_saved: Potential0.5–3 ms heavy mean from shorter repeated vector gathers; confidence reduced by earlier shared-cache regressions. No expected idle benefit; charge setup and occupancy.
hypothesis.confidence: high algebraic equivalence with mapping tests; low-to-medium performance
hypothesis.experiment_cost: coherent component workspace redesign; sanitizer and stress tests
hypothesis.supporting_measurements: Less redundant traffic/barriers without register/shared-memory occupancy losses
hypothesis.scope: Independent current snapshot-compatible control, including unaccepted N14. No N15/N19/N20 composition. Same additional512/516 interleaved boundary oracles on both arms.

measurements.repetition_policy: Equal per-process counts in A-before/B/A-after; all first-use ticks included at equal weight. Pooled controls have twice the candidate sample count.
measurements.scope: One full tick per independent physical restore. A-before / B / A-after per scenario. All CPU/GPU work and correction included; restore, validation and post-tick observation excluded. Unprofiled comparison with recorded GPU admission; no profiler timings or automatic acceptance.

conclusion: Reject. Bridge10.491ms versus8.720/8.985ms controls, chain8.657 versus7.662/7.491, city256 late-debris429.384 versus420.758/412.486. No convincing full-step improvement. The three-sample large-case cohort is a screen, not a precise regression estimate. Component registers rise109 to116 and shared memory1600 to17984bytes; occupancy loss and bank conflicts are hypotheses, not measured causes.
profiling_scope: Existing baseline attribution plus compiler resource inspection; no candidate NCU capture after negative unprofiled application screen.

reassessment.conclusion: Pause shared-vector caching family. Prior partial-cache failures and this full local-recurrence failure do not justify more blind parameter tuning. Next N06b changes parallel decomposition for tiny components while retaining global vector storage. Shared-memory SoA/bank behavior would require instruction/counter evidence before another cache experiment.

sources.finding: Shared memory has32 banks with successive32-bit words assigned to successive banks; conflicting accesses serialize. This motivates checking the actual instruction/layout, but does not establish a conflict or slowdown for N16.

retained: N16 not applied. N13 remains the selected numerical policy; N20 retained isolated CPU change remains separate. No N14 promotion.
